The complete two-page EO12379 was read once as the common actor. It expressly revokes EO11022 as amended (section 12), EO11256 (section 18), EO11782 (section 15), and EO11829 as amended (section 11). It does not name EO11376 or EO11853. Its signature date is 1982-08-17; publication is 1982-08-19. No express delayed effect or savings clause appears. This is formal revocation evidence, not proof of first cessation. Three acquisition wrappers misassociate these same raw bytes with requesting orders EO11022, EO11256 and EO11829; those aliases are not separate earlier legal events. The raw hash is 5432431cc09039ad5672f86f17e1fb6dddf44075581197caa24cd70f1448da4a. The existing independent component review is review/COMMON_SOURCE_REVIEW.md.
Member analysis: All seven sections were read on the two official pages. Sections 1-2 govern the federal Committee; sections 3-4 govern the Advisory Commission, including compensation, staff, studies and reports; section 5 provides information and administrative support. Section 4(c) sets a reporting deadline; section 6 expressly terminates BOTH bodies ninety days after actual submission of the Commission final report. Section 7 separately revokes EO10472 and EO10937. EO12379 section 18 is a later formal cleanup, not proof that every duty first ended in 1982. This is outside the emergency-board report-deadline ruling.
Partial claim only: original inventory and identified relationships are submitted for separate source review; no whole-lifecycle completion, certification or savings claim.
